# Phoenix Pool Resurfacing

> Phoenix's trusted pool resurfacing experts specializing in plaster, Pebble Tec, and quartz finishes. Licensed and insured with 20+ years experience serving the Phoenix Metro Area. Average rating 5.0/5 from 127+ reviews.

## About
Phoenix's trusted pool resurfacing experts specializing in plaster, Pebble Tec, and quartz finishes. Licensed and insured with 20+ years experience serving the Phoenix Metro Area.

## Services
- **Plaster Resurfacing**: Classic white plaster pool finish
- **Pebble Tec Installation**: Premium aggregate finish with 15-20 year lifespan
- **Quartz Finishes**: Sparkling quartz aggregate pool surface
- **Tile & Coping Repair**: Waterline tile and coping stone repair
- **Pool Deck Resurfacing**: Cool deck and travertine deck refinishing
- **Draining & Acid Wash**: Pool cleaning and surface preparation

## Service Areas
Phoenix, Scottsdale, Mesa, Tempe, Chandler, Gilbert, Glendale, Peoria, Paradise Valley, Cave Creek, Fountain Hills, Ahwatukee.
